definitions.gloss: a visible blue vein, especially on the forehead when angry
definitions.explanation: refers to veins becoming visible, particularly used to describe a sign of anger or irritation

examples.japanese: {青筋|あおすじ}を{立|た}てて{怒|おこ}る。
examples.english: To get angry with veins bulging.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{額|ひたい}に{青筋|あおすじ}を{立|た}てていた。
{上司|じょうし}が{青筋|あおすじ}を{立|た}てて{怒鳴|どな}った。
examples.english: My boss shouted with veins popping in anger.

notes:
EXPRESSION OF ANGER:
{青筋|あおすじ}を{立|た}てる is an idiomatic expression meaning to be visibly angry, with the image of veins becoming prominent on the forehead or temple due to intense emotion.

USAGE:
Almost always used in the expression {青筋|あおすじ}を{立|た}てる (to make veins stand out = to be furious).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {青筋|あおすじ}を{立|た}てて{怒|おこ}る - to be furiously angry
- {額|ひたい}に{青筋|あおすじ}を{立|た}てる - to have forehead veins bulging
- こめかみに{青筋|あおすじ}を{浮|う}かべる - to have temple veins showing

RELATED:
- {激怒|げきど} - rage
- {怒|いか}り - anger
- {血管|けっかん} - blood vessel
